<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Rename dashboard folder</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"put"} path={"/perses-public/api/v1/projects/{projectId}/rename"}></MethodEndpoint>



Renames a folder, leaving the rest of its document alone.

The new name goes in `newProjectName`. The body is not validated, so a request that uses any other property name returns 200 and renames nothing.


## Request
